x: In the team race only Len Duquemin showed his best form so that Southend, with Marlow and Banyard prominent, were able to beat us by 4 points.
Further back, John Hall walked quite a good one in the hot conditions to beat Southend's Banyard and Rosser whilst Dave McMullen came under the judges ban as did many other men.
Winner was Olympic Champion Kannenburg of West Germany. Ray had a bad one and was beaten by Banyard of Southend but Len reportedly walked a steady race for 23rd position.
